import pandas as pd
climate = tables['climate']
oni2 = climate[(climate.index_id=='oni') & (climate.avail_season==2)].sort_values('avail_doy')[['avail_doy','value']]
oni1_60 = climate[(climate.index_id=='oni') & (climate.avail_season==1) & (climate.avail_doy<=70)].sort_values('avail_doy')[['avail_doy','value']]

pier = tables['pier']
p2 = pier[pier.ts_season==2]
p2w = p2.assign(wk=(p2.ts_doy//7)*7).groupby('wk').wtmp_c.mean().round(2)
p1 = pier[(pier.ts_season==1) & (pier.ts_doy<=63)]
p1w = p1.assign(wk=(p1.ts_doy//7)*7).groupby('wk').wtmp_c.mean().round(2)

trips = tables['trips']
t2 = trips[(trips.fish_date_season==2) & (trips.fish_date_doy<=60)]
by_cls = t2.groupby('cls').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'n':len(g),'yt':g.yt.sum(),'ang':g.anglers.sum(),'share':g.yt.sum()/g.anglers.sum() if g.anglers.sum() else 0}))

result = {
 'oni2': oni2.to_dict('records'),
 'oni1_60': oni1_60.to_dict('records'),
 'pier2_weekly': p2w.to_dict(),
 'pier1_weekly_samedoy': p1w.to_dict(),
 'trips_by_class_s2_doy1_60': by_cls.to_dict('index'),
}
